syllabus_topics: Linear programming: geometrical method, simplex method, dual problem, special cases
Transportation problem: methods of obtaining feasible solutions: Dantzig’s, minimum element and Vogel’s approximation methods
Discrete linear programming: integer programming, binary programming, general methods of solutions, special methods: allocation problem, scheduling and other problems
Graph theory, network programming, critical path method
Dynamic programming, practical examples of problems solution
Game theory, queueing theory, modeling and simulation, multi-criterion programming
